pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:0.6: ime kho panayyāyo chasaṭṭhisatā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavanejha anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena bhikkhunīsaṅgho lasuṇena pavārito hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.3: yāsaṃ ayyānaṃ lasuṇena attho ahaṃ lasuṇenāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.5: sace bhikkhuniyo āgacchanti ekamekāya bhikkhuniyā dve tayo bhaṇḍike dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.6: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ ussavo hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.13: thullanandā bhikkhunī khettaṃ gantvā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo khettaṃ gantvā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.16: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo khettapālassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.17: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.19: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.22: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpessati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.23: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya athakhvetaṃ bhikkhave appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyāti. athakho bhagavā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhikkhūnaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ tadanulomikaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.25.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa pajāpatī ahosi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.28: athakho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo kālaṃ katvā aññataraṃ haṃsayoniṃ upapajji.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.31: athakho bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī ayaṃ haṃso amhākaṃ ekekaṃ pattaṃ detīti taṃ haṃsarājaṃ gahetvā nippattaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.32: tassa puna jāyamānā pattā setā sampajjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.33: tadāhu bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī atilobhena suvaṇṇā parihīnā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.39: athakho bhagavā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.40: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.41.1: yā pana bhikkhunī lasuṇaṃ khādeyya pācittiyanti.
